provenance: 623 rotary reports in 14 physical trials, with interleaved button notifications. ZCL frames contain no device identifiers. Expected counts are frozen capture interpretations, not calibrated physical measurements: the first report starts a fresh observed trial; later reports use the independently studied timer continuity with +/-5% clock variation, +/-25 ms differential latency, and complete delivery. The one code-1 timer-rollover ambiguity is annotated as -96 from sustained reversal capture. No A/C reset predicate is used to generate expectations. Synthetic edge cases live in Python tests and are not included here.
